title: ailocalpack opt-out list
description: policy/opt-out.json of the registry: games whose publisher asked not to distribute fan translations. Maintainers only. `ailocalpack index build` sets `optOut` on these games in index.json, leaves their packs out and `pack validate` refuses new ones; the app blocks install and generation for them. A broken file stops the index build (dropping an entry would unblock a game). Unknown properties are allowed (forward compatibility); a breaking change raises schemaVersion.

note.description: For maintainers (not shown in the app): who asked and when, a link to the request issue.
